description:
HushTelegram v0.0.25 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.1 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the Google Play build 13.2.1 (org.telegram.messenger) with 82 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. The bundle is signed from this release on, so Morphe Manager shows it as signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc. Most of what's new came from your reports. Free proxies keeps the fastest public MTProto proxies in Telegram's list for you, Ghost mode can make exceptions for the chats you pick, and the message menu gains Hide for me, Delete for them and Forward as plain text. New switches start off, except the two that stop a photo from going out uncropped or with the wrong caption.

If Telegram turns down your login code with API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, that's it refusing the public API ID every patched build carries, the Play one included. Register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: All 2327 runtime tests passed locally. All 664 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 82 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's build (version code 72919) and the Google Play build (version code 72911), and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, resource table, native libraries and alignment. Both builds were patched from this bundle and walked signed in on a Galaxy S22, 22 screens each with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Patch 13.2.1 from Google Play, or telegram.org's 13.2.1 from Telegram's own Telegram APKs for Android channel, since telegram.org's Download button already hands out 13.2.2. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from 0.0.24, patch the same build and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** The telegram.org web build moves from 13.2.0 (72809) to 13.2.1 (72919). Both builds now track Telegram 13.2.1.
* **Telegram:** **Ghost mode** lets channel reads go out now, so a channel you read on this phone shows as read on your other devices too. Nobody in a channel can see who read what, so they learn nothing. Groups and private chats stay unread everywhere else, since there the read is what people would see (#65).
* **Telegram:** With **Ghost mode** and **No read receipts** on, opening a channel post, or one forwarded into a chat, no longer adds your view to its count. The counts still load. Turning on **Hide online status**, or Ghost mode while it's on, now shows you offline on every signed-in account right away instead of whenever Telegram would have timed you out (#71).
* **Telegram:** The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows "Signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc" on the HushTelegram source and remembers that key, so a later bundle signed with any other key, or not signed at all, gets refused instead of loaded.
* **Telegram:** **Free proxies**, under Chat list. Turn it on and HushTelegram downloads a public list of MTProto proxies every 6 hours, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list. Telegram connects through the fastest and moves to another by itself when one stops answering, unless you're using a proxy of your own. **Find free proxies now** runs it right away, even with the switch off, and then only adds them to the list. Proxies you saved yourself are never touched. The phone number screen also always has Telegram's proxy button now, so you can add a proxy before you sign in, which helps where Telegram is blocked (#66).
* **Telegram:** **Proxy order**, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Drag your proxies into the order you like or pin a few on top, and Telegram's own proxy screen lists them that way instead of re-sorting by speed every time it saves. A free proxy you pin becomes yours, so the next refresh won't remove it. **Sort by speed** drops your order and keeps only the pins. With HushTelegram paused the screen goes back to Telegram's order (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Your proxy lists**, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Add the https addresses of up to 5 proxy lists you trust, pages of t.me/proxy or tg://proxy links, and Free proxies reads those instead of the public list, timing them all together and keeping the 10 fastest. A list that can't be read is skipped. Empty the box to go back to the public list. The addresses stay out of settings files (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Proxy in the chat list menu**, under Chat list and off by default. The menu at the top of the chat list always has Proxy, so your saved proxies are one tap away. Telegram only puts it there while a proxy is on or in a country where Telegram is blocked (#67).
* **Telegram:** **Ghost mode** has two new switches in Privacy, both off by default. **Read after you reply** sends the read receipt Ghost mode held back in a chat once you send a message there, so your other devices stop showing that chat as unread. **Read receipts button** puts a double check at the top of the chat list that sends every read receipt Ghost mode is holding for the account you're on. Held receipts last until Telegram restarts.
* **Telegram:** **Ghost mode exceptions**, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. The chats you pick get the opposite of Ghost mode: while it's on they read, type and watch stories as usual, and while it's off they keep back what the Ghost mode switches keep back, view counts included. Pick them in **Exception chats**, or long press chats in the chat list and use **Ghost mode exception** in the three dots menu. Online status isn't one chat's, so it follows Ghost mode everywhere (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Fake typing**, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. Long press chats in the chat list and pick **Fake typing** in the three dots menu, and they show you typing for 10 minutes or until you pick them again. It works with Ghost mode on too. Secret chats can't show it (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Instant lock**, in Privacy and off by default. With a Telegram passcode set, Telegram locks a second or two after you leave it instead of waiting out your Auto-lock time. Your Auto-lock choice stays as it is and comes back when you turn the switch off.
* **Telegram:** **Don't notify contacts**, in Privacy and off by default. When you sign up a phone number that's never used Telegram, the people who have it saved don't get the "joined Telegram" notice. Turn it on before you sign up. On a fresh install, long press the app icon to reach the Hush settings. Accounts that already exist aren't affected.
* **Telegram:** **Suppress screenshot notification**, a new patch with its switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. Telegram stops telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats.
* **Telegram:** **Unlock Premium features**, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram on your phone treats your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits stay the same.
* **Telegram:** **Bypass channel restrictions**, in Privacy and off by default. Channels and chats that turn off forwarding, copying and saving let you do all three. Their stories open up too, so you can share and screenshot them, and save them wherever Telegram lets you save other stories (#52). Its second switch, **Open restricted channels**, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them (#58).
* **Telegram:** **Bypass integrity check**, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator.
* **Telegram:** **Send photos and videos in the best quality**, a fifth switch under **Faster downloads** in HushTelegram settings > Playback, off by default. Photos go out in HD and videos at their own size and quality without a trip to the quality button, and you can still lower one before you send it (#63).
* **Telegram:** **Auto-forwarding rules** forwards now. Under its switch in Privacy, **Forwarding rules** lists your rules for the account you're on, and **Add rule** picks the chat to watch, the chat to send to and whether every message goes or only ones with a photo, video or file. Only messages other people send go out. A forward from any account you're signed in to never goes out again, and neither does a copy of a message a rule already sent to that chat, so rules pointing at each other can't loop, even across two accounts or through channels. Saved Messages can take forwards but isn't offered as a chat to watch. Chats you can't post in, Replies, Telegram's own account and deleted accounts aren't offered to send to, and at most 20 forwards leave a minute. Off by default.
* **Telegram:** **Never send an uncropped photo**, under Conversations and on by default. If Telegram can't finish a crop, say the photo hasn't loaded yet or there's no memory left for the cropped copy, the editor stays open with a short note instead of sending the whole photo. Tap Done or Send again to retry, or Cancel to leave the photo uncropped. Live photos get the same check, including when the still can't be read from its file. Videos crop the way they always did.
* **Telegram:** **My messages**, under Conversations and off by default. A group's menu at the top gets My messages, which opens the chat's search on the messages you sent there, so you can step through them or see them as a list. Channels and private chats don't get it. Morphe Manager lists it under Search (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Text direction**, under Conversations and off by default. Select text in the message box and its menu gets Right to left and Left to right, which start each selected line with an invisible direction mark so it reads that way for everyone. Picking the other one later swaps the mark. Control character opens the list of invisible marks Telegram Desktop has, like RLM or ZWJ, and puts the one you pick where your selection was. Morphe Manager lists it in a new Writing group along with Use normal paste (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Hide for me**, a new item in the message menu, behind its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu in Conversations, off by default. Long press a message, pick Hide for me, and it leaves the chat on this phone, its whole album with it. Nothing goes to Telegram, so everyone else still has it, and it stays out each time you open the chat. Show hidden messages, right below the switch, brings them all back, and so does turning the switch off (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Forward as plain text** joins the message menu on its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. Pick it on a message you could forward, choose a chat, and the words land there as a brand new message from you. Bold, links and the original sender's name stay behind, and custom emoji turn into the regular emoji they stand for (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Delete for them** is a new message menu item for your own messages in chats and groups, on its own switch below Hide for me, off by default. It deletes the message, album included, for everyone else and keeps your copy here with the "deleted" mark Keep deleted messages uses, even while that switch is off. It only shows while Telegram would still let you delete for everyone, so not on old messages in basic groups, and never in Saved Messages, secret chats, bots or channels. Clear kept messages removes those copies too (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Lyrics and song dates**, a new patch with two switches in Playback, both off by default. **Lyrics in the music player** puts Lyrics in the player's menu. It looks the song up on lrclib.net and, when the lyrics are timed, keeps the current line in view as the song plays. **Dates on your profile songs** notes the day you add a song to your profile and shows it after the artist in your profile's song list. The days stay on this phone, so songs added earlier or from another device don't get one (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Chat preview buttons**, under Chat list and off by default. Press and hold a chat and the menu under its preview ends with Open chat, which opens the chat the rest of the way, and Close preview, which puts the preview away (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Screenshot selected messages** is a new switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. It puts a Screenshot button in the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and the messages are saved to Pictures/Telegram as one picture, the way the chat shows them, with the wallpaper, date headers and times. Every message you picked has to be on screen. Secret chats never get a picture, and chats that don't allow saving only do when **Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving** is on (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Keep captions with their photos**, under Conversations and on by default. When the photos you pick in the attach menu each have their own caption, unpicking the first one or dragging another photo in front of it used to put the first photo's caption on the new first photo. Now every caption stays with its own photo.
* **Telegram:** **Folder icons on tabs** is a new switch under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default, that takes an app restart. Each folder tab above the chat list gets a small icon in front of its name, in the name's own color: a chat bubble for All Chats, a person, group, channel or bot for a folder of only that kind of chat, Telegram's unread and unmuted icons for folders that drop read or muted chats, and a plain folder for the rest. With a pack picked under **Folder icons**, the tabs use that pack's icon for the folder's name instead.
* **Telegram:** **Open a chat by ID**, under Look and feel below the Show user and chat IDs switches. Type the number from a profile's ID row and it opens that person, group or channel, as long as this app has already seen it, say someone who wrote in a group you opened. Bot-style IDs like -100 followed by the channel's number work too (#71).
* **Telegram:** **Hide sender names when forwarding** covers the Share sheet now, and forwards to several chats at once, which still went out with the original author (#70). The Share sheet's send menu starts on Hide sender's name, and you can switch it back there. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender.
* **Telegram:** With **Turn videos only from the full screen button** on, a video you put in full screen with the button stays sideways on 13.2 instead of standing back up as soon as you turn the phone (#27).
* **Telegram:** **Save to Downloads** in the message menu saves every photo of an album, not just the one you long-pressed (#46).
* **Telegram:** **Save downloaded files** no longer logs an error in its diagnostics whenever a profile photo or a sticker finishes downloading (#27).
* **Telegram:** **Save downloaded files** no longer puts one file's contents under another file's name (#7). When two different files had the same name and size, Telegram could open the first one's file for the second instead of downloading it, and the copy in Download/Telegram came out with the wrong contents. That second file now stays out of Download/Telegram, and so does any named file Telegram finds already saved instead of downloading it. Files whose names end in .enc get copied as well, where they used to fail.
* **Telegram:** The account rows in HushTelegram settings and the checks that tell your own accounts apart no longer log an error on 13.2.1 from Google Play. They only look at the four account slots that build has.
* **Telegram:** Turning **UnifiedPush notifications** off, or picking another push app, when your phone couldn't save the change (a full phone, say) no longer leaves the row saying the push app ended the sign-up. Turning it back on signs up again, and a move to another app goes ahead once the old one lets go. A refusal, an address or an end the old app sends in the middle of a move can't undo it anymore, and Telegram goes back to Google's push until the new app sends its address.
* **Telegram:** With large text, the HushTelegram settings list no longer jumps a few pixels when you go back from a search. The top bar used to come back a little shorter after a long title had to shrink to fit.
* **Telegram:** With Telegram set to Português (Brasil), HushTelegram settings and messages come out in Portuguese. They were in English, because Telegram runs that language with no region and only the Brazilian table had Portuguese text.
* **Telegram:** In German, the text under **Receive only mode** and **Power off accounts** says "du" like the rest of HushTelegram settings.
* **Telegram:** A settings search while an import, an export or a diagnostic report is running shows the same rows it shows the rest of the time. Searching "Import settings" during an import used to list **Export settings** too, since that row said "Importing settings" for the moment.
* **Telegram:** With **Hide reactions under messages** on, a new reaction to your message gets marked as seen once you scroll to it. The heart in the chat list and the reactions button in the chat used to stay there for good. Telegram's pop-up animation for that reaction no longer plays over the hidden row either (#48).
